sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The echtra is a class of Irish adventure tale. The hero often journeys to the Otherworld on the venture. The imram, the voyage tale, also visits that distant realm. Famous echtra texts follow named heroes. Bé Chuma, a fairy woman, desires Art son of Conn. The sons of Eochaid Mugmedón bring the birth of Niall, a king of Tara. Nera enters the Otherworld through the cave of Cruachan. Connla yields to a fairy woman's lure. Cormac follows fairy music to seek an Otherworld lover. Laoghaire Mac Crimthann makes his own venture.
